svg.title: Relativistic momentum versus speed
svg.desc: Relativistic momentum p_rel = γmu versus speed u from 0 to the speed of light c. The momentum stays small at low speeds, rises steeply above about 0.8c, and grows without limit as u approaches c, shown by a dashed vertical line. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Relativistic momentum grows rapidly near c
p = γmv, compared with mv. Momentum is normalized by mc. The cursor stops at 0.97c, where the
relativistic and classical predictions differ strongly.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
